cases.question: ¿Cuántas sesiones cerradas tuvo cada caja durante marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(*) AS sesiones FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY sesiones DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, COUNT(cs.id) AS sesiones_cerradas FROM public.cash_session AS cs JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se registró en ventas en efectivo y otros medios, desglosado por caja, en las sesiones cerradas durante marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS ventas_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS ventas_otros FROM cash_session cs JOIN cash_register cr ON cr.id = cs.cash_register_id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY cr.id, cr.name ORDER BY caja LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT cr.name AS caja, SUM(cs.sales_cash) AS ventas_efectivo, SUM(cs.sales_other) AS ventas_otros FROM public.cash_session AS cs JOIN public.cash_register AS cr ON cs.cash_register_id = cr.id WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND cs.closed_at < CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY cr.name LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue la suma de las diferencias de cierre de las sesiones cerradas en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cs.difference), 0) AS diferencia FROM cash_session cs WHERE cs.status = 'CLOSED' AND cs.closed_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND cs.closed_at < DATE '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50
